pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Alaska?
pages.d: Yes, up to the time limit posted at that rest stop. The official Alaska rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Arizona?
pages.d: ADOT sets no time limit, but camping is prohibited. The official Arizona rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a BC rest area?
pages.d: No overnight camping. Check posted hours at each rest area. The official British Columbia rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.
pages.h: Can you sleep at a rest area in British Columbia?

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in California?
pages.d: Yes, but no more than 8 hours in any 24-hour period. The official California rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Florida?
pages.d: Only briefly. Cars can stay 3 hours. Commercial drivers can stay 10 hours. The official Florida rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Hawaii?
pages.d: Not overnight. Hawaii bans using a vehicle to live or sleep in on public property from 6 p.m. to 6 a.m. The official rule for cars and trucks, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Idaho?
pages.d: Yes, for up to 10 hours at interstate rest areas and 16 hours on other state highways. The official Idaho rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Illinois?
pages.d: Only briefly. A stop at an interstate rest area can't exceed 3 hours. The official Illinois rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Kentucky?
pages.d: Only briefly. Stays are limited to 4 hours in any 24 hours. The official Kentucky rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Maryland?
pages.d: No. Overnight parking is prohibited and visits are limited to 3 hours. The official Maryland rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Minnesota?
pages.d: Cars can stop for up to 4 hours where posted and commercial drivers up to 10 hours. The official Minnesota rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Montana?
pages.d: Yes. Overnight parking is allowed for up to 12 hours, in one space. The official Montana rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Nebraska?
pages.d: No overnight. Stays are limited to 10 hours and overnight parking is prohibited. The official Nebraska rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Nevada?
pages.d: Yes, within a limit of 18 hours in any 2-week period. The official Nevada rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in New Hampshire?
pages.d: New Hampshire sets no rest area time limit, but tents and sleeping on the ground are banned. The official rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in North Carolina?
pages.d: No. NCDOT says staying overnight at its rest areas is prohibited. The official North Carolina rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Ohio?
pages.d: You can rest in your vehicle, but don't leave it unattended for 3 hours or more. The official Ohio rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Oregon?
pages.d: Yes, up to 12 hours in any 24-hour period. The official Oregon rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Pennsylvania?
pages.d: Only briefly. Stays are limited to 2 hours in a 24-hour period unless posted. The official Pennsylvania rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in South Dakota?
pages.d: Only to rest. Cars can rest up to 3 hours. Commercial drivers up to 10 hours. The official South Dakota rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Tennessee?
pages.d: No. Overnight parking isn't allowed and there's a 2-hour limit. The official Tennessee rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Texas?
pages.d: Yes, you can stay up to 24 hours. The official Texas rule for cars, trucks and camping at rest areas, with its source so you can check it yourself.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Utah?
pages.d: UDOT sets no hour limit. Extended stays are allowed and monitored. No overnight camping. The official Utah rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Vermont?
pages.d: Vermont sets no time limit, but overnight camping at rest areas is banned. The official Vermont rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Virginia?
pages.d: No. Overnight parking is not permitted. The official Virginia rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Washington?
pages.d: Yes, up to 8 hours in any 24-hour period. The official Washington rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.

pages.t: Can you sleep at a rest area in Wisconsin?
pages.d: Not long-term. Parking over 24 hours, or a shorter posted limit, isn't allowed. The official Wisconsin rule for cars, trucks and camping, with its source.
